changes.before: Budget measure associated with the published ORC 122.175 computer data center sales and use tax exemption framework. The retained code page identifies HB 96 and a 2025-09-30 section date; the specific veto/override treatment and current provision-level operation remain unresolved.
changes.after: LSC's enacted comparison separates two R.C. 122.175 provisions: DEVCD11 removes the OBM Director as a recipient of Tax Credit Authority copies of computer data-center exemption applications; TAXCD117 marks as vetoed the Senate proposal to bar new exemption agreements beginning October 1, 2025. Governor veto item 58 on PDF page 44 deletes the date limitation from enrolled-budget page 167 and describes exemption awards as discretionary, not automatic. These distinguish an enacted application-recipient change from the vetoed cutoff; they do not establish a later item 58 override outcome, project eligibility or current legal force.
